Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

Indian Standard 
SPECIFICATION FOR REAFn^ro 

STOOL f REVOLVING, FOR HOSPITAL USE 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for revolving stool used in hospitals. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 

3. Material 

3.1 7op — Stainless steel sheet conforming to Designation 04Cr18NH0or07Cr18Ni9 of IS: 6911-1972 
'Specification for stainless steel plate, sheet and strip *. 

3.2 Legs and Central Tube — Electric resistance butt-welded steel tubes ( ERW ) conforming to 
IS : 2039-1964 'Specification for steel tubes for bicycle and allied purposes '• 

3.3 Bush and Central Spindle — Mild steel round bars conforming to IS : 2591-1969 ' Specification for 
hot rolled bars for threaded components ( first revision ) ' or IS : 4855-1968 ' Specification for bright 
steel bars for machining '. 

3.4 Shoes — Vulcanized rubber compound conforming to Type B Grade IV of IS : 5192-1969 
'Specification for vulcanized rubber compounds', plastics or any other resilient material which 
prevents floor scratches and resists slipping. 

4. Manufacture and Workmanship 

4.1 The components shall be assembled by welding in accordance with the relevant requirements of 
IS : 816-1969 ' Code of practice for use of metal arc welding for general construction in mild steel 
( first revision ) \ IS : 819-1957 ' Code of practice for resistance spot welding for light assemblies in 
mild steel ' and IS : 1323-1966 ' Code of practice for oxy-acetylene welding for structural work in mild 
steel (revised) \ 

4.1.1 The welding shall fully penetrate and shall be sound in every detail. The welds shall be 
finished flush. In the finished stage, there shall be no exposed sharp edges or other unsealed 
formations which may harbour dirt or other foreign matter. 

4.2 The stool shall be free from dents, burrs and sharp edges. 

4.3 The top shall be dished as shown in Fig. 1. 

4.4 When the stool stands.on a level surface, its top shall be horizontal. 

5. Finish— The top of the stool shall be passivated and polished bright. All other exposed 
surfaces shall be stove-enamelled in accordance with 5.1 of IS : 4033-1968 ' General requirements 
for hospital furniture \ The enamels for the undercoat and finishing coat shall conform to IS : 2932- 
1964 * Specification for enamel, synthetic, exterior, Type 1, (a) undercoating, (b) finishing, colour as 
required '. 

6. Adhesion Test — As prescribed in 6.1.1 of IS : 4033-1968. 

7. Marking — The stool shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade- 
mark, or shall have a label fixed to it bearing this information. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. v 



Adopted 15 November 1973
